name: word-snap
description: Word Snap — vocabulary matching with a personal review engine. Web app plus an Android (Capacitor) build.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
